name: mediaway-nodejs-bindings
description: Node.js bindings for Mediaway (@mediaway/container, @mediaway/encoder, @mediaway/device) over the C ABI

scripts.test: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/ffi/tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/container/tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs test/mux-roundtrip.test.ts && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs test/all-formats-smoke.test.ts && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs test/decode-roundtrip.test.ts
